page.overview:
Who is Masked Guards?

In Shaolin Monks, they have the ability to block almost all of the player's attacks, causing the player to rethink how to fight them. The Masked Guards fight with a bladed staff-like weapon (the naginata), and use a katana as a secondary means of assault. Also, a single Masked Guard appeared in the opening of the Mortal Kombat II, and a dead Masked Guard is seen in the opening shot of the Mortal Kombat: Armageddon and Mortal Kombat 11 introduction video. John Vogel played the Masked Guards seen in the original Mortal Kombat arcade game.

In Mortal Kombat (2011) and Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks, Kung Lao disguises himself as a Masked Guard to gain access to the Mortal Kombat tournament. The Masked Guards can also be seen around the Courtyard.

They also do battle with the three chosen heroes of Earthrealm by Raiden and the Shaolin Monks, Liu Kang, Johnny Cage and Sonya Blade after they are discovered spying on Tsung, Goro, and Kano, but are defeated. More arrived, but were fended off by Raiden (which leads to Johnny taunting the guards by saying that they got lucky).
